review.note: Mekanism, Generators, Tools and Additions share one repo and one scan (861 items). Teaching pillar for Verdant: ore processing chain (dust, clump, shard, crystal) multiplies metal yield; FE machines in factory tiers; energy cubes and induction matrix for storage; universal cables; QIO storage; generators (heat, bio, gas, solar, wind, turbine, fission, fusion) - see the curated entries in data/mekanism-generators.json. Additions adds plastic blocks, balloons and baby mobs (decorative, optional). Built-in support: Flux Networks, ProjectE, AE2 (via AppMek), Curios, Farmer's Delight; supported by 12 mods.
